mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, price, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM products ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, description, price, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM products WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')) ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, quantity, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, quantity = #{quantity}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
